summary: The authored concept is ready, but the visible World Cup Hub theme still overrides generated Semantic OS roles with unproven local UI colors. Re-establish one generated semantic token authority, retain only separately identified team/flag identity colors, and prepare the project for deterministic regeneration.
decisions: Generated tokens.css is the only authority for application UI color roles in both light and dark themes.
Team and flag identity colors may remain product-specific only in a clearly separated identity namespace with provenance and must never be the sole status cue.
Do not hand-edit generated tokens.css; correct brand inputs, runtime-policy consumption, or emitter behavior and let Ontology Compiler regenerate it.

gate_results.evidence: runtime-theme.css contains many local UI HEX overrides after tokens.css; audit found 30 application-surface colors without current Semantic OS coordinates or derivation metadata.
The Semantic OS Markdown authority is current and unchanged, so the defect is downstream consumption rather than source migration.

risks: Deleting runtime overrides before confirming regenerated light/dark semantic roles could temporarily reduce contrast or break app-specific aliases.
Identity colors must not be confused with general success, warning, danger, or selection roles.
next_action: Token Curator removes unproven application color overrides, establishes explicit identity-only exceptions and semantic aliases, validates contrast and source provenance, and returns a ready handoff before Ontology Compiler regenerates tokens.
